verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the lower PRAY now comes first and "When Life Is Rough" sits below "When Life Is Great". The four text lines are staggered on unrelated axes, the divider is stranded far to the left, and the rose is cropped and pushed to the edge, so the message no longer reads. B keeps the Rough/PRAY | Great/PRAY order with the divider between the two halves, but the halves don't mirror each other: the left stacks vertically with a big gap and PRAY is small, while the right runs in a single line with PRAY larger. The rose is crowded against the right half, and the right half of the layout is unbalanced.
